questions.q: Introducing a man, a woman said, 'His wife is the only daughter of my father.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.why: The only daughter of her father is the woman herself, so the man is her husband.

questions.q: Ravi is 12th from the top and 19th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in the class?
questions.why: Total = 12 + 19 - 1 = 30, which is not among options A to D.

questions.q: D and E are a married couple, and D is the husband. A and B are their children. A is B's brother, and B is the mother of C. How is C related to E?
questions.why: E is the mother of B, and B is the mother of C, so C is E's grandchild. Nothing in the statement tells us whether C is male or female.

questions.q: If 15 men complete a work in 24 days, how many men will complete the same work in 10 days?
What comes next in the series? 4, 12, 36, 108, 324, …
questions.why: Each term is multiplied by 3. Next: 972. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Ajay walks 6 km East, then turns left and walks 8 km. How far is Ajay from the starting point?
questions.why: The two legs are at right angles: √(6² + 8²) = 10 km. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the next number in the series: 5, 11, 23, 47, 95, ?
questions.why: Each term is double the previous one plus 1: 95 x 2 + 1 = 191.

questions.q: Rekha is the sister of Suresh. Suresh is the father of Meera. How is Rekha related to Meera?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Paternal aunt. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statement: "If the train is delayed, I will be late." Which judgment follows?
opts: If I am late, the train was delayed
The train causes all my lateness
I will be late if the train is delayed
questions.why: Only the restatement is certain; A reverses the if-then. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

questions.q: Vijay walks 6 km North, then turns left and walks 8 km. How far is Vijay from the starting point?
questions.why: The two legs are at right angles: √(6² + 8²) = 10 km. GPSC-style practice item.
